title: Timeline
description: Fiori timeline: TimelineItem and collapsible TimelineGroupItem, vertical and horizontal layouts, value-state icons, Load More / scroll growing, the SAP keyboard model (ui5-timeline).

usage.summary: Present object events and changes in chronological order.
useWhen: Help users review when an object changed or an event occurred.
Show read-only system events or recorded posts with names, timestamps and optional collapsible groups.
Use growing="Button" or "Scroll" with onLoadMore when users need to retrieve further entries.

avoidWhen.when: Browse independent items whose order is not a chronology.
Compare event attributes in columns or sort a data-driven history.
